# Skowak

> Skowak is an AI transformation boutique that builds production AI systems for operationally complex, regulated businesses.

Skowak builds production AI systems for operationally complex, regulated businesses. Twenty years turning dense domains into software people actually use.

Skowak works through two categories of service: AI Design & Development, three
engagement tiers built on Evaluation-Driven Design where nothing counts until it
is running in the client's business and their team can maintain it; and AI
Fluency, programs for executives, engineering teams, and apprenticeship and
workforce-development partners. Domains: insurance
underwriting, federal healthcare data, solar and energy operations, developer
infrastructure, education.

## AI Design & Development

- [AI Opportunity Sprint](https://skowak.com/services/ai-opportunity-sprint/) A 2-3 week fixed-fee engagement that maps where AI can create value in your operation and pressure-tests each candidate against your data, constraints and people before any code is written.
- [Agentic Workflow Redesign](https://skowak.com/services/agentic-workflow-redesign/) A 4-6 week fixed-scope engagement that redesigns the workflow around an AI system: agent placement, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, escalation paths, and an evaluation framework for every AI-assisted decision point.
- [Forward-Deployed Design Engineering](https://skowak.com/services/forward-deployed-design-engineering/) A monthly embedded engagement, minimum three months, in which Skowak designs, builds, instruments and proves a production AI system inside your team, then transfers ownership.

## AI Fluency

- [Executive AI Fluency](https://skowak.com/services/executive-ai-fluency/) A half-day decision-competency program for leadership teams and boards: evaluate AI vendor claims, price the risk in a deployment, and answer the AI-strategy question before it's asked. Not a coding class.
- [Builder AI Fluency](https://skowak.com/services/builder-ai-fluency/) A multi-week embedded series that teaches engineering teams the Evaluation-Driven Design practices behind every Skowak engagement, so ownership transfer after a project ends is a working skill, not a handoff document.
- [AI Apprenticeship & Workforce Development](https://skowak.com/services/ai-apprenticeship/) Skowak designs the AI instructional and competency components of structured apprenticeship and workforce-development programs, for enterprise and government organizations, employers, and apprenticeship sponsors: RTI, competency frameworks, curriculum, mentor training, and assessment.

## Pages

- [Building reliable systems out of an unreliable ingredient](https://skowak.com/writing/reliable-systems/): LLMs will produce confident wrong answers. The question isn't whether AI makes mistakes  it's whether you can build reliable systems using this unpredictable ingredient.

- [SunPower case study](https://skowak.com/work/sunpower/): Compressing commercial solar design from days to 25 minutes  UX architecture and product design for SunPower's digital platform.
- [Bitscopic, federal healthcare data case study](https://skowak.com/work/federal-health/): Cutting clinical data review effort by up to 80% for Bitscopic, health-data analysis, reporting, and decision-support interfaces inside a government health system.
- [Craftal case study](https://skowak.com/work/craftal/): Building a research-based multi-agent product-planning system  custom DSL, RAG pipeline, deterministic verification, and structured planning workflows with human review.
- [Fidelity Life case study](https://skowak.com/work/fidelity-life/): Taking insurance applications from four days to thirty minutes  underwriting, case management, and product configuration for a multi-year transformation.
